from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional

class Party(BaseModel):
    """Represents a party in the case."""
    name: str = Field(description="Name of the party as written in the document")
    role: str = Field(description="Role of the party, e.g. Appellant, Appellee, Respondent")

class FeeRecord(BaseModel):
    """Represents a specific court fee or cost obligation."""
    fee_type: str = Field(description="Type of fee, e.g. Court Fee, Preservation Fee")
    amount: str = Field(description="The fee amount as a string to preserve units and decimals")
    payer: str = Field(description="Who bears the fee, e.g. 'Appellant', specific name")

class RulingDetail(BaseModel):
    """Represents a specific ruling order or outcome."""
    description: str = Field(description="Description of the order, e.g. 'Pay damages', 'Dismiss appeal'")
    amount: Optional[str] = Field(description="Specific amount involved in this order, if any")

class CourtRecord(BaseModel):
    """Represents a court mentioned in the document."""
    name: str = Field(description="Name of the court")
    case_level: Optional[str] = Field(description="Level of the case, e.g. First Instance, Second Instance")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Top-level class aggregating all extracted information for a single document."""
    case_numbers: list[str] = Field(description="All case numbers mentioned in the document")
    parties: list[Party] = Field(description="All parties involved with their roles")
    fees: list[FeeRecord] = Field(description="All financial obligations regarding fees")
    rulings: list[RulingDetail] = Field(description="Specific rulings made by the court")
    courts: list[CourtRecord] = Field(description="Courts involved in the proceedings")
    document_types: list[str] = Field(description="Type of document, e.g. Civil Judgment, Ruling")
    outcome_keywords: list[str] = Field(description="Key phrases summarizing the outcome, e.g. '驳回上诉，维持原判'")
